items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And Jack didn't buy "Night Train," so the rest is history.

ctx.x: And Jack didn't buy "Night Train," so the rest is history.

Anyway, I'm going to move on to Wardell Gray. Wardell didn't drive, you know, so I used to pick Wardell up, and I guess we recorded just about every other day for Ross Russell and Dial Records. I can remember on the way to one record date I was humming something. I think it was maybe part of a theme that Paramount used to use in their news feature. [SINGS REFRAIN] Anyway, we got to the date, and sure enough, Wardell remembered it and interpolated it in some piece that we played. I don't remember the name, but in…
